use default

mobius(value: int) -> int is
    let remaining mut = value
    let factors mut = 0
    let factor mut = 2

    while factor * factor <= remaining do
        if remaining % factor == 0 then
            remaining = remaining / factor
            factors = factors + 1

            if remaining % factor == 0 then return 0 fi
        fi

        factor = factor + 1
    od

    if remaining > 1 then
        factors = factors + 1
    fi

    if factors % 2 == 0 then 1 else -1 fi
si

for row in 0..10 do
    let start = if row == 0 then 1 else row * 10 fi
    let indent = if row == 0 then "   " else "" fi
    let cells = (start::row * 10 + 9) |> map(n => "{mobius(n),3}")

    write_line("{row * 10,4}:{indent}{cells |> join("")}")
